onboardingUsageProfileBody: We will add starter help pages tailored to you. You can delete or edit them anytime.
onboardingUsageProfileMinSelectionError: Select at least one use to continue.
vaultStarterHomeIntroNotes: Folio is a great place to capture ideas, link thoughts, and organize personal notes. These starter pages help you begin writing without a rigid structure.
vaultStarterHomeIntroTasks: Folio helps you combine notes and task lists in the same vault. These starter pages focus on tracking, priorities, and regular review.
vaultStarterHomeIntroProjects: Organize work by projects, meetings, and deliverables inside a page tree. These starter pages give you a focused starting outline.
vaultStarterHomeIntroKnowledge: Build a personal wiki with indexes, topic sheets, and reading notes. These starter pages encourage linking topics and review.
vaultStarterHomeIntroJournal: Use Folio as a space for daily reflection and monthly review. These starter pages suggest light routines to keep the habit.
vaultStarterHomeIntroStudy: Centralize class notes, study plans, and reviews in one place. These starter pages are oriented to courses and preparation.
vaultStarterHomeTodoNotes1: Dump three loose ideas into the idea inbox
vaultStarterHomeTodoNotes2: Create a quick-capture note with the / menu
vaultStarterHomeTodoNotes3: Link two pages from the sidebar
vaultStarterHomeTodoTasks1: Add three tasks to the task board
vaultStarterHomeTodoTasks2: Mark one task done and set a date on another
vaultStarterHomeTodoProjects1: Create the first page for a project
vaultStarterHomeTodoProjects3: Define the next milestone in the project hub
vaultStarterHomeTodoKnowledge1: Add three topics to the content index
vaultStarterHomeTodoKnowledge2: Create a topic sheet with links
vaultStarterHomeTodoStudy2: Add three key concepts to your notes
vaultStarterShortcutsBullet1: Each page is made of blocks: paragraphs, headings, lists, tables, and more.
vaultStarterShortcutsBullet2: The sidebar organizes pages and subpages in a tree.
vaultStarterShortcutsBullet3: Search and history help you regain context quickly.
vaultStarterShortcutsKeySettings: Ctrl+, opens Settings and Ctrl+L locks the vault.
vaultStarterShortcutsCallout: Press / inside a paragraph to insert blocks without leaving the keyboard.
vaultStarterNotesInboxIntro: Use this page as an inbox: jot loose ideas, links, and thoughts to review later.
vaultStarterNotesInboxBullet1: Write one idea per bullet or short paragraph.
vaultStarterNotesInboxBullet2: When an idea matures, create a dedicated page and link it.
vaultStarterNotesInboxBullet3: Clear the inbox in brief weekly reviews.
vaultStarterNotesInboxTodo2: Move one idea to its own page
vaultStarterNotesInboxCallout: Do not aim for perfection when dumping: the inbox is for thinking out loud.
vaultStarterNotesCaptureIntro: Minimal template to note something with context, source, and next steps.
vaultStarterNotesCaptureBullet1: Short title and paragraph with the main detail.
vaultStarterNotesCaptureBullet2: Quote or callout block for the key takeaway.
vaultStarterNotesCaptureBullet3: Optional action list if it applies.
vaultStarterNotesCaptureTodo2: Add tags or link related pages
vaultStarterNotesCaptureCallout: Try the / menu to insert a list or table without changing blocks.
vaultStarterTasksDashboardIntro: Centralize todos with todo blocks, dates in properties, and visual priority.
vaultStarterTasksDashboardBullet1: Separate today, this week, and someday tasks.
vaultStarterTasksDashboardBullet2: Use checklists for small repeatable steps.
vaultStarterTasksDashboardBullet3: Open the vault task view to see everything together.
vaultStarterTasksDashboardTodo1: Add three tasks with different priority
vaultStarterTasksDashboardCallout: Tasks can also live inside project pages.
vaultStarterTasksWeeklyIntro: Review what was done, what is pending, and what comes next week.
vaultStarterTasksWeeklyBullet1: List of wins and blockers from the week.
vaultStarterTasksWeeklyBullet2: Three priorities for the next seven days.
vaultStarterTasksWeeklyBullet3: Short notes to delegate or postpone.
vaultStarterTasksWeeklyTodo2: Pick the number one Monday priority
vaultStarterTasksWeeklyCallout: A 15-minute review is usually enough to keep the system alive.
vaultStarterProjectsHubIntro: Group goal, status, risks, and links to child pages for each project.
vaultStarterProjectsHubBullet1: Executive summary in the first paragraph.
vaultStarterProjectsHubBullet3: Links to meetings, decisions, and docs.
vaultStarterProjectsHubCallout: Duplicate this page as a template for new projects.
vaultStarterProjectsMeetingIntro: Template for attendees, agenda, decisions, and actions with owner.
vaultStarterProjectsMeetingBullet1: Note decisions in callouts to find them later.
vaultStarterProjectsMeetingBullet2: Turn agreements into todos with dates if needed.
vaultStarterProjectsMeetingBullet3: Link the meeting from the project hub.
vaultStarterProjectsMeetingTodo2: Log at least one action with owner
vaultStarterProjectsMeetingCallout: If you record audio, try meeting note blocks with transcription.
vaultStarterKnowledgeIndexIntro: Index page with links to topics, areas, and note collections.
vaultStarterKnowledgeIndexBullet1: Group by broad areas and link child sheets.
vaultStarterKnowledgeIndexBullet2: Add a one-line summary under each link.
vaultStarterKnowledgeIndexBullet3: Review the index when creating new pages.
vaultStarterKnowledgeIndexTodo1: Add three topics to the index
vaultStarterKnowledgeIndexCallout: A good index reduces friction when finding old ideas.
vaultStarterKnowledgeTopicIntro: Structure to define, exemplify, and link a topic with others.
vaultStarterKnowledgeTopicBullet1: Brief definition and why it matters.
vaultStarterKnowledgeTopicBullet3: Open questions or gaps to research.
vaultStarterKnowledgeTopicTodo1: Write the definition in one sentence
vaultStarterKnowledgeTopicCallout: Sheets mature over time: revisit them after reading or experimenting.
vaultStarterKnowledgeReadingIntro: Log source, key ideas, and how to apply them in work or study.
vaultStarterKnowledgeReadingBullet2: Three ideas you want to keep.
vaultStarterKnowledgeReadingTodo2: Extract at least two quotes or ideas
vaultStarterKnowledgeReadingCallout: Link readings from the index to see your living library.
vaultStarterJournalDailyIntro: Brief space to record how the day went, what you learned, and what you appreciate.
vaultStarterJournalDailyBullet3: What do I want to repeat or avoid tomorrow?
vaultStarterJournalDailyTodo1: Write at least three lines about today
vaultStarterJournalDailyCallout: Consistency matters more than length: one honest paragraph is enough.
vaultStarterJournalMonthlyIntro: Close the month reviewing wins, learnings, and adjustments for the next.
vaultStarterJournalMonthlyBullet1: Three moments you want to remember.
vaultStarterJournalMonthlyBullet2: One habit that worked and one to change.
vaultStarterJournalMonthlyBullet3: One realistic goal for the coming month.
vaultStarterJournalMonthlyTodo1: List two wins from the month
vaultStarterJournalMonthlyTodo2: Pick one focus for next month
vaultStarterJournalMonthlyCallout: You can duplicate this page each month and keep the history.
vaultStarterStudyCourseIntro: Organize modules, concepts, and exercises under a course page.
vaultStarterStudyCourseTodo1: Name the course and teacher or platform
vaultStarterStudyCourseCallout: Combine notes with code or equation blocks when needed.
vaultStarterStudyPlanIntro: Plan sessions, reviews, and assessments with todos and dates.
vaultStarterStudyPlanTodo2: Mark the next review on the calendar
vaultStarterStudyPlanCallout: Adjust the plan each Sunday: little text, lots of clarity.
